findings.entity: Two white coffee mugs held by customer and waitress
findings.description: At 01:11–01:12 the customer and waitress each hold a separate white mug. As they bring the mugs together, their silhouettes collapse into one mug at 01:13. By 01:14 the waitress withdraws an empty right hand and only the customer’s mug remains on the exposed counter; no separate mug is carried away or visibly placed elsewhere.
